title: breweria africana
intro: Breweria africana, commonly known as African Breweria, is a plant species belonging to the family Oleaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its reported health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Breweria africana include analgesic, antipyretic, and expectorant effects, making it a potential remedy for pain relief, fever reduction, and cough management. The bioactive constituents of Breweria africana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
